title: Alignment Probe
description: A toolkit for red-teaming language models by automatically generating adversarial prompts and measuring alignment degradation across safety-critical dimensions.

title: SafeGuard Eval
description: An evaluation framework that benchmarks content moderation systems against a curated dataset of edge cases spanning 12 harm categories.

title: Interpretability Lens
description: Interactive visualization tool for exploring neuron activations and attention patterns in transformer models, designed to make mechanistic interpretability accessible to researchers.

title: Bias Compass
description: A diagnostic tool that measures and visualizes demographic bias in text generation models across multiple axes including gender, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.

title: Guardrails SDK
description: A lightweight Python SDK for adding configurable safety guardrails to any LLM application, with built-in support for topic filtering, PII detection, and output validation.

title: RLHF Monitor
description: A monitoring dashboard that tracks reward model behavior during RLHF training, flagging reward hacking patterns and distributional shift in real time.
